title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Substituted Representation

subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: A paralegal is scheduled to represent a client in Small Claims Court but falls suddenly ill the night before. The paralegal asks a colleague from a different firm to cover the hearing and hands over the client's file. The paralegal does not inform the client. What rule has been breached?
options: No rule has been breached; this is standard emergency delegation.
The paralegal breached confidentiality and the rule against delegating or handing over representation without the client's consent.
The paralegal breached the rule regarding fee splitting.
The colleague breached the rules on advertising by taking another's client.
questions.explain: A paralegal-client relationship is built on confidentiality and client choice. A paralegal cannot share confidential file information with an external licensee, nor unilaterally transfer representation to another practitioner, without the client's express knowledge and consent.
